_comment: Self-contained on purpose — the contents of @repo/typescript-config/base.json
are inlined rather than extended. This app is mirrored verbatim to the public
github.com/ojodotso/mcp-server repo, which has no workspace to resolve
@repo/* from, so an `extends` there would not build. Same reasoning as the
`root: true` in .eslintrc.cjs. Keep in sync with base.json when it changes.
